name: Fireworks
description: Audio-reactive particle-burst fireworks that pop at random positions on the canvas, max 3 simultaneously.

width.description: Bounding box width as fraction of canvas

height.description: Bounding box height as fraction of canvas

baseColor.description: Default firework colour (used unless rainbowMode is on)

particleCount.description: Particles per firework — baked at assembly

gravity.description: Downward pull on each particle per frame

spawnRate.description: Per-frame chance of spawning in an idle slot at silence

bassSpawnBoost.description: Adds bassEnergy * this to spawn chance

spawnOnBeat.description: Force-spawn one firework on every onBeat (if a slot is idle)

rainbowMode.description: Pick random RGB per spawn instead of baseColor
